children: US gaming operator's Q3 revenue rose 10% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 beat analyst expectations
Company repurchased 624,000 shares for $7.2 mln in Q3
Company says it is expanding in Chicago with the receipt of first licenses
Accel expects continued development at Fairmount Park racino
Company sees flexibility to invest organically and pursue acquisitions due to strong cash flow
ILLINOIS PORTFOLIO OPTIMIZATION - Co said Illinois revenue growth was driven by improved hold-per-day and a higher performing location mix
MARKET EXPANSION - Co cited strong performances in Georgia, Nebraska, Louisiana, ongoing Nevada expansion and Fairmount Park gaming revenue growth
OPERATING LEVERAGE - Co attributed faster Adjusted EBITDA growth to operating leverage, portfolio quality and disciplined capital deployment
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 6 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the casinos & gaming peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Accel Entertainment, Inc. is $16.00, about 34.3% above its November 2 closing price of $11.91
The stock recently traded at 14 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 14 three months ago
